chart_review_items.title: Unify basic grouped metrics and source provenance
chart_review_items.current_state: Named grouped results support one group field and count/sum/average; pivot has richer reducers.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: The same metric has the same meaning in bars, cards, tables, and future heatmaps.
acceptance_criteria: Count, sum, and mean agree across the first consumers.
Define row count versus valid-value count and behavior when there are no valid values.
Separate complete group membership from included numeric contributors.
Support zero, one, and eventually two grouping keys through incremental adapters.
Keep existing saved configurations readable; avoid a big-bang rewrite.

chart_review_items.title: Make grouped bars participate in linked filtering
chart_review_items.current_state: Aggregate bar click opens contributor inspection instead of a filter.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Revenue by region filters the workspace as naturally as count by region.
acceptance_criteria: A mark can select its source group.
An explicit separate action retains value/contributor inspection.
Selecting and clearing groups updates all linked views correctly.
Invalid metric contributors do not disappear from group membership without an explicit rule.
Keyboard selection and restored selection match pointer behavior.

chart_review_items.title: Add basic metric cards
chart_review_items.current_state: Filtered-row status exists but no registered arbitrary metric-card type.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: The selected population has a visible count and metric summary.
acceptance_criteria: Count, sum, and mean are available through shared reducers.
Units and formatting use field metadata.
Population scope is named.
Empty/invalid and zero results are visually distinct.
Inspect action explains contributors without changing selection.

chart_review_items.title: Introduce selection-only undo and redo
chart_review_items.current_state: Clear-all, removable filter chips, precise ranges, and brush clearing exist; recommendation extends these.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Exploration is reversible without requiring universal application undo.
acceptance_criteria: One completed gesture creates one history step.
Undo/redo restores complete filter state across linked views.
Clear-all itself can be undone.
Data replacement resets or rebases history by an explicit policy.
History is bounded; no raw dataset copies per brush update.
